items.title: CTest case is a leftover template and passes arguments the module does not accept

findings.title: Bundled test cannot pass: unknown --sigma flag and non-DWI input
findings.explanation: DiffusionComplexityMap.xml defines no 'sigma' parameter, so the CLI parser rejects '--sigma 2.5' and the test fails immediately; additionally the input is a CT head volume with no DWMRI_gradient/DWMRI_b-value metadata, so even without the flag the filter would find zero gradients and fail. The extension therefore has no working automated verification of its output.
findings.suggestion: Replace the test invocation with the real parameters (--diseq/--qvalue/--numBins) and a small DWI NRRD with proper DWMRI metadata, and regenerate the baseline.

findings.title: CTest case is a leftover template and passes arguments the module does not accept
findings.explanation: The test runs DiffusionComplexityMapTest with '--sigma 2.5' and a CT head image (CTHeadAxial). The module has no --sigma parameter, and the command omits the required brain-mask argument, so the test would fail or pass only by accident. It also compares against a baseline that is not described. The test provides no real validation of the DC algorithm.
findings.suggestion: Replace with a DWI test case that supplies inputVolume, maskVolume and outputVolume with the real parameter names, and document the expected baseline generation.

items.title: Documented "leave mask blank" path fails: mask is always read

findings.title: Documented "leave mask blank" path fails: mask is always read
findings.explanation: DiffusionComplexityMap.xml line 26 promises "If left blank, the entire input image will be used as input", and the filter has a no-mask branch (itkDiffusionComplexityMappingImageFilter.hxx line 119: 'if (this->GetNumberOfIndexedInputs()==1)'). But the CLI unconditionally sets and updates the mask reader, so an empty maskVolume makes itk::ImageFileReader throw and the CLI exits with EXIT_FAILURE. The no-mask code path is unreachable, so users following the documented workflow get an error instead of a whole-image result.
findings.suggestion: Only create/update the mask reader and call SetDiffusionSpace when maskVolume is non-empty; otherwise leave the filter with a single input so the existing whole-image branch is used.

findings.title: Brain mask documented as optional but always read, so blank mask fails
findings.explanation: The XML description says 'If left blank, the entire input image will be used as input', but the parameter is declared as a plain <image type="label"> with no optional flag, and main() always calls readerMask->SetFileName(maskVolume) and Update() before filter->SetDiffusionSpace(readerMask->GetOutput()). With an empty mask name, ITK throws, the exception is caught in main, and the module returns EXIT_FAILURE. The documented fallback path (GenerateData's GetNumberOfIndexedInputs()==1 branch) is therefore unreachable from the CLI.
findings.suggestion: Only call SetDiffusionSpace when maskVolume is non-empty, or make the mask optional in the XML and document the behavior accordingly.

items.title: Histogram frequencies indexed by gradient index instead of bin index

findings.title: Histogram frequencies indexed by gradient index instead of bin index
findings.explanation: The histogram was initialized with m_HistogramBins bins (line 434), but the entropy sum loops over the number of gradient components and calls GetFrequency(j) with that index. When the number of gradient volumes exceeds the number of bins (e.g. --numBins 4 with a 30-direction DWI, or a small diffusion range with the automatic bin estimate), GetFrequency reads past the end of the DenseFrequencyContainer2 vector (undefined behaviour / garbage or crash), and even when in range the entropy is summed over the wrong bins, so the reported DC values are wrong. The same pattern is repeated in calculatesDisequilibriumMapping (lines 548-550).
findings.suggestion: Iterate over the histogram bins (e.g. HistogramType::Iterator or GetSize()[0]) when accumulating p, and keep the gradient loop only for filling the histogram.

items.title: Mask/input geometry mismatch causes out-of-bounds write into usedMaskSpace

findings.title: Mask/input geometry mismatch causes out-of-bounds write into usedMaskSpace
findings.explanation: usedMaskSpace is allocated with the DWI's requested region (lines 113-117) but the loop is bounded by the mask's own region. If the user supplies a mask with a different size (e.g. a mask from another series, or a label map with a different slice count), usedMaskIt runs past the end of its buffer and writes out of bounds. ITK iterators do not bounds-check in release builds, so this is memory corruption / a crash of the CLI process rather than a clean error message.
findings.suggestion: Verify that the mask's LargestPossibleRegion and spacing/origin/direction match the input image and report a clear error otherwise (or resample the mask); iterate over the intersection region only.

items.title: Automatic bin estimate can return 0 bins, then p_e = 1/0

findings.title: Automatic bin estimate can return 0 bins, then p_e = 1/0
findings.explanation: numberOfBins is an unsigned int computed from a double division; if max == min (constant or all-zero diffusion values inside the mask) the result is 0. Histogram::Initialize is then called with size 0 and, in calculatesDisequilibriumMapping line 545, 'p_e = 1.0/m_HistogramBins' divides by zero, producing inf/NaN output or an ITK exception.
findings.suggestion: Clamp the computed bin count to a sane minimum (e.g. 4, matching the XML constraint) and guard against max == min before building the histogram.

items.title: Conflicting license notices: Apache-2.0 headers vs MIT LICENSE

findings.title: Conflicting license notices: Apache-2.0 headers vs MIT LICENSE
findings.evidence:
Copyright 2017 Antonio Carlos da Silva Senra Filho and Fabricio Henrique Simozo

   Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
findings.explanation: The filter sources state Apache-2.0 with a different copyright holder, while the repository LICENSE and README say MIT. Both permit distribution, so this is not blocking, but users and packagers cannot tell which terms apply to the filter code.
findings.suggestion: Clarify in LICENSE or the headers which license covers the ITK filter files, and make the copyright holders consistent.

items.title: Debug output always enabled in the CLI

findings.title: Debug output always enabled in the CLI
findings.explanation: DebugModeOn() is hard-coded, so every run prints the NRRD metadata keys, gradient counts and bin counts to stdout. This clutters the Slicer CLI output window for all users and cannot be turned off from the GUI.
findings.suggestion: Expose debug mode as a boolean CLI parameter defaulting to false, or remove the call.

items.title: Division by zero when the DWI has no b0 volume

findings.title: Division by zero when the DWI has no b0 volume
findings.explanation: numberOfReferenceImages is derived from the number of components minus the number of non-zero gradients; a DWI without a b0 volume (or with headers lacking DWMRI_gradient tags, as in the bundled test data) makes it 0, so the mean S0 becomes inf/NaN and every downstream diffusion value and the whole DC map are NaN. The missing b-value case is only printed as a warning (line 200-203) and processing continues.
findings.suggestion: Validate that at least one b0 volume and at least one gradient exist and abort with a clear error message otherwise.

findings.title: Divisions by zero and unbounded bin count
findings.explanation: createDiffusionSpace divides by numberOfReferenceImages, which is zero when the header has no b=0 volumes, producing NaN for every voxel. histogramBinByDiffusionVarianceRegression can return 0 bins for a small range, and calculatesEntropyMapping/calculatesDisequilibriumMapping then compute 1.0/m_HistogramBins (division by zero). The automatic bin count is also not clamped, unlike the manual range 4-500 in the XML. The missing b0 case only prints to cerr and continues, so the user gets a silently wrong map instead of an error.
findings.suggestion: Validate numberOfReferenceImages > 0 and b0 > 0 and throw itk::ExceptionObject otherwise; clamp the automatic bin count to a sane minimum (e.g. >= 4) before use.

items.title: ITK components may not cover all headers used

findings.title: ITK components may not cover all headers used
findings.explanation: The code includes itkDiffusionTensor3DReconstructionImageFilter.h and itkNrrdImageIO.h, but only ITKIOImageBase and ITKSmoothing are requested in find_package. Depending on the ITK build, the link or include could fail. Not verified by building.
findings.suggestion: Add the ITK modules that provide the DTI reconstruction and NRRD IO headers (for example ITKDiffusionTensorImage / ITKIONRRD) and confirm a clean build.

items.title: Missing b-value leads to silent division by zero

findings.title: Missing b-value leads to silent division by zero
findings.explanation: If the DWMRI_b-value key is absent, b0 stays 0 and createDiffusionWeightedValues divides by it, yielding inf/NaN gradient values. The code prints only 'BValue not specified in header file' to cerr and proceeds, so the module reports success with a corrupt output.
findings.suggestion: Raise an exception instead of continuing when the b-value is missing.

items.title: Stray '>' in the mask image element of the CLI XML

findings.title: Stray '>' in the mask image element of the CLI XML
findings.explanation: The extra '>' becomes character data inside the <image> element. It is well-formed XML so the module still loads, but it is a malformed parameter declaration that can confuse the SlicerExecutionModel parser and any tooling that reads the XML.
findings.suggestion: Remove the stray '>' so the line reads '<image type="label">'.

findings.title: Malformed XML text and misspelled enum element names
findings.explanation: The image element for the mask has a stray '>' character in its content, and the disequilibrium enum uses the misspelled labels 'desiquilibriumFunction' and 'Kullback-Leiber'. These are cosmetic but affect the user-facing UI and the parameter name.
findings.suggestion: Remove the stray '>' and correct the spelling of the labels and parameter name (keeping compatibility if the parameter name is already used by saved scenes).

items.title: Uninitialized values when gradient string has fewer than three numbers

findings.title: Uninitialized values when gradient string has fewer than three numbers
findings.explanation: x, y, z are declared without initialization and passed to sscanf. If a DWMRI_gradient metadata value is malformed, the vector gets indeterminate values, and the gradient is then used in the reference-vs-gradient decision.
findings.suggestion: Initialize x, y, z to zero and check that sscanf returns 3.

items.title: log() of zero/negative values guarded with '||' instead of '&&'

findings.title: log() of zero/negative values guarded with '||' instead of '&&'
findings.explanation: The guard passes whenever either value is non-zero, so a zero gradient value with a non-zero b0 (common in background/noisy voxels) yields log(0) = -inf, and negative values yield NaN. These propagate into the histogram range estimate and the entropy/disequilibrium maps; only isinf is filtered later, NaN is not.
findings.suggestion: Require both values to be strictly positive (and b0 > 0) before taking the logarithm, and set the diffusion value to 0 otherwise.

items.title: CLI XML declares license 'Slicer' while the code is MIT/Apache-2.0

findings.title: CLI XML declares license 'Slicer' while the code is MIT/Apache-2.0
findings.explanation: The repository LICENSE is MIT and the ITK filter files are Apache-2.0; the XML metadata shown in the Slicer module panel states a different license, which is misleading for users checking terms. Distribution permission itself is clear.
findings.suggestion: Set the XML license field to 'MIT' (and note the Apache-2.0 filter files in the acknowledgements or a NOTICE).

items.title: Leftover project name in mkdocs configuration

findings.title: Leftover project name in mkdocs configuration
findings.explanation: The docs site header shows another project's repository name, which is confusing for users looking for the source of this extension. Cosmetic only.
findings.suggestion: Set repo_name to CSIM-Toolkits/SlicerDiffusionComplexityMap.

items.title: No research-use disclaimer and no user tutorial or sample DWI data

findings.title: No research-use disclaimer and no user tutorial or sample DWI data
findings.evidence:
### Diffusion Complexity map

This module is able to reconstruct the `Diffusion Complexity`  map from a standard Diffusion-Weighted MRI imaging acquisition.
findings.explanation: The documentation is a single page covering installation and example images; it does not explain the required NRRD DWMRI metadata, the meaning of the q value / disequilibrium functions, or provide sample data, and there is no statement that the DC map is a research metric not validated for clinical diagnosis. Users must infer the workflow from the XML tooltips.
findings.suggestion: Add a short usage walkthrough with a downloadable DWI sample, describe the parameters, and add a research-use-only disclaimer.
